idea-plugin.name: MBTraining Karate Pack
idea-plugin.description:
MBTraining Karate Pack is a proof of concept (POC) training content pack for MBTraining Engine Framework.

It demonstrates how a pack can plug into the engine and deliver a guided learning path for Karate API testing.

What it includes:

  • A staged roadmap from basic scripting to end-to-end API flow exercises
  • Pack-defined onboarding content and learner guidance
  • Exercise metadata consumed by the engine for progress tracking and validation
